name: com.midmanstudio.hudman
description: Game-agnostic HUD item catalog and layout persistence. HudItemType is a code-generated enum (ScriptableObject-provider + block/priority/lock-file pattern, same shape as com.midmanstudio.utilities' EffectType) so each game contributes its own HUD item catalog without the package ever hardcoding one. HudLayoutRuntime tracks per-item position/scale/opacity/visibility and named layouts with Questly's hybrid persistence split: CaptureState/RestoreState for a host-owned snapshot, SaveToMdix/LoadFromMdix for a package-owned .mdix file. The actual dragging is not reimplemented here -- HudItemDraggableAdapter plugs a HUD item into com.midmanstudio.dragndrop's DragDropController via its uGUI adapter, and only allows dragging while HudLayoutRuntime.IsEditMode is true (off by default, alongside SetEditMode/ToggleEditMode/EditModeChanged, mirroring the existing Selection pattern -- exiting edit mode clears the current selection too). HudItemView exposes a Runtime property and a Bound event so a sibling component whose own Awake() may run before HudItemView.Bind() (called explicitly by host bootstrap code, not from Awake()) can still reliably pick it up once available. Deliberately excludes anything about how a game stages its HUD-editing UI (separate scene, overlay, additive load, etc.) -- that's host-specific staging, not package concern. See com.midmanstudio.gensettings' Samples~/editHUD_hudman_integration_example.cs for the host-side wiring this was built for.
